fieldValues.title: Where do a meeting's working records live?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the owner ("Would minutes exist in this full form within the master repo? Would they add bloat?") and the experiments in Research: Protocol evolution, part 4. No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Everything in the master; discovery and compositions default to the outcome types.
- B. Work each meeting in a copy of the master, merge the outcome records back, attach the whole meeting as a file.
- C. A separate repository per meeting, with outcomes re-created in the master (new identities; the engine refuses a merge).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether readers need to follow a minute to its fragment inside the master; how often a meeting is re-opened after merging; whether an attached file is acceptable provenance for a trustee.
fieldValues.next_action: Use option B for the next real meeting and note every time the missing working records are wanted.
